description: The Cryptominium Profile (CM Profile) of a tracked coin, in four fixed groups: what Cryptominium has established (contracts matched, chains), what it has measured (the cost of selling on-chain and on exchange order books, with dates; price history), what it has written with sources (what the coin can do and through which company), and what it has not established. Use this when someone asks what is known about a coin, how well documented it is, or whether it depends on a company. Each line links to its evidence. Also returns this week's changes as short tags and the 7-day high, low and latest price, as the coin page chart marks them. A record, not a rating: it is not a view on whether to hold the coin.

token.description: Ticker, name or contract address, e.g. "USDC", "pepe", "0x8335…".

name: coin_profile
title: CM Profile: what is known about a coin, and what is not
